author: A Google user
review_text: What were you guys thinking? Why would you discontinue your web service and force us to use the app? It would have been plausible if the app itself worked seamlessly but it's worse than an alpha build. Three updates later, the app is still buggy and interface is so much confusing, user unfriendly, cluttered and bad designed. I have been trying to pay my internet Worldlink bill since morning but all in vain. At least if there was web service present, I would have resorted to that but you guys messed it all up. My advice, make sure that app works fine and then only you can retire your web services; don't treat us like we are nothing. If not, a lot of us are going to move to better alternatives.
